answer: Require each identity to escrow a 580-unit bond and serve a thirty epoch probation. Each round it completes one random task and gathers four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent partners; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for twelve rounds. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm thus locks 580 units per alias and replays thirty rounds, while a trellis of linked traces exposes the ring, quartz receipts certify reviews, and hollow rotation keeps tasks distinct.
